title: Salmonella Detection with Spin Column Extraction and 7500-FAST Enrichment PCR
author: Laura Goodman
materials: Copy the results into the provided SecureSheet file.

steps.title: Prepare RVS Broth
steps.instruction: Prepare the Rappaport Vassiliadis (RVS) media based on the required batch size using RO water and HIMEDIA #M1491 RVS broth powder.

substeps.instruction: Add half the required RO water and a sterile stir bar to a sterile flask.
Place flask on a stir plate and rotate the stir bar.
Add the entire amount of RVS powder while stirring.
Add the remaining amount of water to the flask.
Heat the flask until the powder is completely dissolved.
Dispense 10 ml of broth into sterile 20 x 125 mm screw-capped tubes using sterile tubing and the DoseIt; loosely cap tubes.
Autoclave tubes for 15 minutes on liquid cycle at 121°C.
Allow to cool to room temperature (RT) and tighten caps.
Label racks as 'RVS Broth' with date made, initials, and expiration date (6 months from preparation).
Perform QC according to manufacturer's directions.
Store RVS Broth at 2-8°C protected from light.

steps.title: Prepare Biosafety Cabinet (BSC)
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace for sample processing.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly disinfect the BSC using a disinfectant spray.
Place absorbent bench paper in the BSC.
Allow the BSC to run for several minutes before placing items inside.

steps.title: Set Up Enrichment
steps.instruction: Inoculate samples with RVS broth for enrichment.

substeps.instruction: Place the following in the BSC: prepared RVS aliquots (9ml per sample plus one negative control), racks for 15 ml tubes, 10% bleach-soaked towels in a plastic holder, biohazard bag, labeled samples, and optional positive control cultures (S. Typhimurium and S. Dublin) or a sterile 10 µL loop.
For bovine intestinal scrapings in PBS (1ml sample in 15 ml tube), do not transfer the sample out of the tube.
Place the first sample in a rack and loosen the cap; clean gloved hand with 10% bleach towel.
Pour one 9ml RVS aliquot into the sample tube, recap, and discard the empty aliquot tube.
Clean gloved hand with 10% bleach towel and return the tube to the rack; clean gloves again.
Repeat for all remaining samples.
Reserve one un-inoculated RVS aliquot as a negative setup enrichment control.
Optional: Inoculate one positive control using a sterile loop.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated samples to enrich Salmonella.

substeps.instruction: Move racks to a 40-44°C incubator (shaking preferred).
Incubate overnight for at least 18-24 hours.

steps.title: Extract DNA from Culture
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction using a modified DNeasy process.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of culture to a labeled microcentrifuge tube, centrifuge at 5,000 g for 10 minutes, and remove supernatant (clean gloves with 10% bleach between tubes to avoid cross-contamination).
Add 180 μL Buffer ATL to the pellet and resuspend (heat ATL to 50-55°C first if cloudy/precipitate is present).
Add 20 μL Proteinase K and vortex.
Incubate at 56°C for a minimum of 1 hour or overnight, vortexing periodically.
Optional: Add 4 μL RNase A, vortex, and incubate at RT for 3-5 minutes.
Add 200 μL Buffer AL to the tube.
Add 200 μL ethanol (200 proof), mix by vortexing, and pulse spin.
Pipet the mixture into a labeled DNeasy Mini spin column and centrifuge at 6,000xg for 1 minute; discard flow-through and collection tube.
Add 500 μL Buffer AW1 and centrifuge for 1 minute at 6,000xg (8,000rpm); discard flow-through and collection tube.
Transfer column to a new collection tube and centrifuge for 1 minute at 18,000-20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) to dry.
Add 500 μL Buffer AW1 and centrifuge for 1 minute at 6,000xg (8,000rpm); discard flow-through and collection tube.
Add 500 μL Buffer AW2 and centrifuge for 1 minute at 6,000xg (8,000rpm); discard flow-through and collection tube.
Transfer column to a new collection tube and centrifuge for 1 minute at 18,000-20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) to dry.
Place column in a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and pipet 100 μL Buffer EB directly onto the membrane.
Incubate at RT for 1 minute and centrifuge for 1 minute at 18,000-20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) to elute.
Store DNA at 4°C for up to 48 hours or -20°C for long term storage.

steps.title: Program ABI 7500-FAST PCR
steps.instruction: Configure the thermocycler using fast mode and SDS v1.4 settings.

substeps.instruction: Stage 1: 1 cycle at 95°C for 20 seconds.
Stage 2: 40 cycles of 95°C for 3 seconds and 60°C for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Set up reactions at room temperature without using cold blocks or ice.

substeps.instruction: Remove rounded caps from tube strips one row at a time.
Add 30 µl of sample nucleic acid elution to the PCR tube containing lyophilized master mix; wait 3-5 seconds, then resuspend by pipetting up and down 2-3 times.
Add 30 µl of negative amplification control to a PCR tube with master mix; wait 3-5 seconds, then resuspend by pipetting up and down 2-3 times.
Add 30 µl of positive amplification control to a PCR tube with master mix; wait 3-5 seconds, then resuspend by pipetting up and down 2-3 times.
Cap tubes with flat caps, ensuring the strip is seated level; mark one end of the strip for orientation.
Pulse spin strip tubes to collect liquid and remove air bubbles.

steps.title: Run and Analyze PCR
steps.instruction: Execute the PCR run and interpret results based on FAM and VIC signals.

substeps.instruction: Place samples in the ABI-7500 FAST thermocycler using the tube strip adapter, balancing the tubes on each side.
Analyze results using automatic analysis; all samples must have a VIC (internal control) signal.
If VIC is >35 or undetermined, repeat PCR using a 1:5 dilution of the sample in nuclease-free water.
Export data to Excel and interpret: FAM (Salmonella) and VIC (Internal Control).
Interpretations: FAM undetermined/VIC <35 = Not Detected; FAM detected/VIC <35 = Positive; FAM detected/VIC ≥35 = Suspect; FAM undetermined/VIC undetermined = Inconclusive.
Optional: Proceed with culture confirmation for samples with a detected Salmonella (FAM) Ct.
